verdict.rationale: Exporting account and transaction data is a fair question for a corporate card product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that ernd offers data export in open formats or a documented way to leave with your data. The 'withdraw it from the app' line concerns withdrawing something from the app, not exporting data, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
